limits: Synthetic reduced graphs and short trajectories only; no model-family or full-workflow qualification.
Each target uses its own committed source references from a separate source CI host; this is not a same-host native-package experiment.
Actual ATen dispatch is not measured by the product; CPU flags do not establish operator dispatch or numerical causality.
Native library identities use a process cache which may predate the Euler case; macOS loaded maps are explicitly unavailable.
Existing component and CLIP profiles remain open; no tolerance, fixture or runtime dependency was changed to obtain agreement.
